sentences.text:
Coram: Sri Ananda Sen, J.
---------
For the Appellant(s) : Mr. Sheo Kumar Singh, Advocate
For the State : Mr. V.S. Sahay, A.P.P.
 ---------
11/ Dated: 16.02.2024
Heard, the learned counsel for the parties.
The notice to the O.P. No.2- victim has already been served.
This is prayer for anticipatory bail for alleged committing an offence under Sections 376/377/201/313/504/506/34 of IPC and under Section 3(I)(S) & (2) (va) of SC/ST Act.
These appellants are the brother and mother of the main accused.
The main accused approached this Court in Criminal Appeal (SJ) No.271 of 2023 for grant of regular bail.

The co-ordinate Bench of this Court considering the nature of allegation and considering that the victim was 30 years old and having a child and she voluntarily developed relationship with the main accused and also considering the submission of the informant that she has compromised the dispute with the main accused and the case was filed due to misunderstanding, co-ordinate Bench of this Court granted regular bail to the main accused by setting aside the impugned judgment passed by the learned Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Palamau at Daltonganj.

Since the main accused has been released on bail, I am inclined to allow this appeal, I direct the petitioner to surrender before the learned Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Palamau at Daltonganj in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No.04 of 2023 within three weeks, on his surrender and he will be released on furnishing bail bond and sureties as fixed by the trial court.
